History of Present Illness:
 ___ yo woman with chronic pancreatitis, pancreatic insuficiency, 
glucose intolerance recently admitted with ___ cellulitis 
presents with 3 days of nausea, vomiting and diarrhea similar to 
prior episodes which she has been told are secondary to chronic 
pancreatitis (seen by Dr. ___. She was in USOH until three 
days ago when she had fairly sudden onset of diarrhea, constant 
nausea, vomiting which started soon after eating 2 slices of 
cheese pizza. No one else became ill and she has eaten pizza 
without problems in the past but does try to avoid fatty foods 
secondary to chronic pancreatitis and takes Creon supplements. 
She had also noted approx. 2 days of abdominal fullness and 
bloating prior to onset of symptoms. Vomiting (non bloody, 
mucus, ___ x per day, within ___ hour of consuming 
any food or liquid anything. She has only had emesis x 1 this am 
but has not eaten anything. Her last PO intake was yesterday 
around noon. She takes Zofran at home, but with no relief x ___ 
days. Also reports diarrhea which started around the same time, 
few hours before emesis. Has had approx ___ loose BMs per day 
which she describes as ""greasy, loose and watery, yellow/brown 
pale color."" Last BM around 4pm today. At baseline, has 2 loose 
BMs per day. Denies melena/hematochezia. She is feeling bloated, 
but denies cramps.  
.  
Also notes that diarrhea worse approx. ___ hour after eating or 
drinking, even water. She has fleeting,sharp pains in her lower 
abdomen prior to BM but denies any abdominal pain currently. She 
has also been feeling much more fatigued with dizziness and 
lightheadedness upon standing.  
.  
The patient has not had any changes in her medications other 
than using Nystatin cream x 2 days for yeast infection. She also 
had prolonged antibiotic course for cellulitis ___ months ago. 
Denies F/NS but has had occasional chills. Denies sick contacts, 
travel, eating out (other than pizza). had rapid weight loss 
___ (35 pounds), but this denies any recent weight 
changes other than a few pounds of intentional weight loss since 
___.  
.  
In ED, initial vitals were T 97.8 HR 73 BP 139/73 RR 18 100%RA. 
She recive 1L NS, Reglan 10mg IV with improvement of nausea. On 
floor, she is feeling better with improved nausea and no 
vomiting or diarrhea since this am. She has only been taking in 
sips of water and ginger ale.  
.
ROS: As above. Denies Cp, SOB, cough, visual changes, headaches. 
Notes recent yeast infection under breasts, in groin, vaginal 
area, abdominal folds. Also reports diffuse myalgias x approx. 3 
months similar to prior myalgias with Lipitor. Currently on 
Simvastatin

Brief Hospital Course:
Impression  
___ yo woman with chronic pancreatitis, glucose intolerance a/w 
nausea, vomiting, diarrhea similar to prior episodes which she 
relates to chronic pancreatitis.  

BRIEF HOSPITAL COURSE BY PROBLEM  
1. Diarrhea/Nausea/Vomiting: Patient had fairly acute onset of 
nausea, vomiting and diarrhea x 2 days which she related to 
dietary indiscretion, specifically eating 2 slices of cheese 
pizza. Lipase, LFTs were WNL. 1 Stool sample was sent for cx and 
C. diff toxin. Results were still pending at the time of this 
summary. She was started on a clears diet, advanced to full 
liquids in am of ___ and advanced to regular diet for lunch on 
___. She tolerated these dietary advances without nausea or 
vomiting and had 2 formed BMs on ___ which was c/w baseline. She 
was also rehydrated with IVF and continued on Creon supplements 
and home Zofran for nausea. 
  
2. Abdominal Pain: Patient denied abdominal pain but did have 
epigastric tenderness with deep palpation. LFTs, lipase WNL. She 
was given Tylenol prn pain.   
  
3. Candidal yeast infection: Intertriginous erythema with 
satellite lesions c/w ___. Pt also has DM, risk factor for 
yeast infections. She was continued on Nystatin cream.  
  
4. Myalgias: Pt has had diffuse myalgias similar to prior muscle 
pain on Lipitor. Had previously been on Zetia but then changed 
to Simvastatin. CKs, LFTs checked and were WNL.   

5. HTN: Continued on Metoprolol and valsartan. Well controlled.  

  
6. Hyperlipidemia: Continued on statin for now. Should follow up 
as outpateint regarding further characterization of myalgias, ? 
relation to statin.   
  
7. Chronic medical problems: Continued on home regimen 
medications.   
  
8. Code: Full Code. HCP son.

Discharge Instructions:
You were admitted to the hospital with nausea, vomiting and 
diarrhea, likely secondary to your chronic pancreatitis. Since 
you were unable to tolerate food or liquids at home, you were 
dehydrated when you came into the hospital. We gave you IV 
fluids and treated your nausea with IV Zofran. Your symptoms 
improved and you were able to tolerate a regular diet prior to 
discharge.

We did not make any changes to your home medications.

Please call your doctor or return to the ER if you have 
persistent nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, dizziness, fever >101, 
you are unable to tolerate food or liquids or if you have any 
other concerning symptoms.
